subject: planner: Add Revision check in tryLockMDLAndUpdateSchemaIfNecessary (#54963)
summary: Reviewed diff in `pkg/planner/core/preprocess.go` only: adds a `TableInfo.Revision` guard and switches index/column comparisons to maps inside `tryLockMDLAndUpdateSchemaIfNecessary` to avoid unnecessary/expensive scans when schema is unchanged. Verified `model.TableInfo.Revision` is a per-table schema version and is incremented on every persisted table-metadata update (`pkg/meta/meta.go:UpdateTable`), so the new guard should not skip required safety checks. Checked later history up to `upstream/master` and the same core logic remains; no Blocker/High correctness, SQL semantics, consistency, or concurrency issues identified in this change.
